Package Dither

Class Dithering

java.lang.Object
Dither.Dithering
public class Dithering extends Object
The Dithering class performs image dithering using the error diffusion method. The Dithering contains objects ScatteringMat and Palette. Only 8-bit RGB image is suitable for conversion.
